## Purpose

Terminal control, user/group lookup, identity APIs, tty databases, utmpx records, and interactive program boundaries.

- `systems/users-terminals` (47 wrappers)

2. Introduce one broken fixture or commented-out trap.

5. Add one regression test or corpus expectation before moving on.
